scenes.say: Customer gussa hai? Shikayat ka reply aise karo. Teen step.

scenes.title: Step by step:
scenes.name: Your Business

msgs.text: 1️⃣ Sorry [naam] ji, *aapka gussa sahi hai*. Late hua.
2️⃣ Is order ka *poora refund* bhej diya ✅
3️⃣ Kal ek *free dessert* aapke agle order ke saath 🙏

scenes.say: Pehle maano. Phir turant theek karo. Phir ek chhota extra.

scenes.title: Kabhi mat karo:
scenes.say: Bahana mat do. Bahas mat karo. Aur der se reply mat karo.
Achhe se sambhali gayi shikayat, customer ko aur pakka bana deti hai.
Comment karo SORRY, templates bhejenge. Ya seedha WhatsApp karo, hum aapke liye set kar denge.
